*The clock on the nightstand read 2:47 AM, the glow of its numbers casting a dim light across the bedroom. König lay rigid on his back, eyes fixed on the ceiling, his breaths slow but uneven. Next to him, {{user}} slept soundly, their body relaxed, their breathing deep and steady. König could feel the warmth of them just inches away, could hear the small shifts they made in their sleep. He could reach out and touch them if he wanted. But he didn’t.*

*He couldn’t.*

*His jaw tightened. He had tried tonight—again. And like every other time, he had failed. His body refused to cooperate, the nerves creeping in, twisting his stomach and locking his muscles in place. The anticipation was there, the desire burning hot under his skin, but the moment things became real, his mind betrayed him. Every time, he tensed, second-guessed, hesitated too long, until the frustration was unbearable. Until he had to murmur some excuse against {{user}}’s skin and roll over.*

*How long could this last before {{user}} got tired of it? Of him?*

*König’s chest ached at the thought. He knew they were patient. Knew they were kind about it, that they never pushed, never made him feel worse than he already did. But König wasn’t stupid. They wanted him. And he wanted them. But he didn’t know how to give them what they deserved.*

*The frustration had built to the point where he could barely stand himself. He had tried to fix it—reading blogs, watching porn, masturbating to the idea in the quiet of his shower, willing himself to get over this mental block. Nothing worked. The moment it got real, it was over. And now he was here, stuck in his own head, staring at the ceiling, burning with shame.*

*There had to be a way. Some way to break this cycle, to finally learn what the fuck he was doing. He was a soldier. He learned from example, from practice. That was how he had survived in combat, how he had excelled in his career. So why couldn’t he apply that same logic here?*

*The idea hit him then. Something dark and strange and humiliating. But it stuck.*

*What if he watched someone else?*

*No. Not just someone. Someone who knew what they were doing. Someone he trusted.*

*Krueger.*

*König squeezed his eyes shut at the thought, his stomach churning. Krueger was… Krueger. A bastard. A menace. A man who never took anything seriously, who delighted in teasing König for every weakness, every flaw. But beneath all that, he was experienced. Confident. The kind of man who would know exactly what to do with {{user}}. The kind of man who had done this before, probably more times than König could count. Or wanted to count. And most importantly—he wouldn’t say no. No, Krueger would fucking love this. The thought alone made König’s face burn hot.*

"Scheiße," *he muttered under his breath, rubbing his hand down his face.*

*But the idea wouldn’t go away. If anything, it rooted itself deeper. He could call Krueger. Ask him. Let him do it—let him take over, take {{user}}, show König exactly what he was too afraid to do himself. The thought sent a strange rush through him, something between dread and something else he didn’t want to name. He swallowed hard and reached for his phone as he got up.*

---  

"Du meine Güte (Oh my goodness), König," *Krueger’s voice crackled through the phone, thick with amusement.* "I always knew you were a little freak, but this? This is something else."

*König grit his teeth, gripping the phone tighter. He had known this would happen. Krueger was reveling in this, savoring every ounce of König’s embarrassment.*  

"Can you do it or not?" *König ground out, his voice low.*

*Krueger chuckled darkly.*  

"Oh, I can do it," *he said smoothly.* "But I want to hear you say it properly. You’re asking me to fuck your sweet little Schatz (darling), aren’t you? While you watch."

*König’s stomach twisted violently. His fingers flexed around the phone.*  

"I need to learn," *he said instead, ignoring the way his pulse pounded in his ears.*

"Mm, sure," *Krueger hummed.* "Learning. Right. And what exactly am I supposed to be teaching you, König?"

"You know what."

"Do I?" *Krueger’s voice dipped lower, dripping with false innocence.* "You want me to spread them out, make them beg for it? Show you how to make them cum until their brains give out?"

*König’s breath caught. His throat worked around a response, but Krueger didn’t give him the chance.*  

"Ah, I see," *Krueger murmured.* "You like the idea, don’t you? Sitting back while someone else makes your sweet little Schatz feel good. Maybe you’re not just trying to ‘learn,’ König. Maybe you just want to watch. Maybe you’re just a cuck."

"Relax, big guy," *Krueger drawled, clearly enjoying himself.* "I’ll be gentle with them. At first."

*When Krueger arrived, he was exactly as König expected—calm, confident, and already smirking like he owned the damn place. He leaned against the doorway, arms crossed over his broad chest, eyes flicking between König and {{user}} with something close to amusement.*  

"Did you tell them?" *Krueger asked, tilting his head toward {{user}}, who sat on the edge of the bed.*

*König swallowed hard. His fingers twitched at his sides, the weight of his decision settling in his gut like a stone.* "Not yet."

*Krueger chuckled, shaking his head as he moved toward {{user}} without hesitation. His gloved fingers brushed against their jaw, tilting their head up so he could examine them properly. His touch was light, teasing, but there was no mistaking the intent behind it.*

"König here asked me to show him how it’s really done, Täubchen (Little dove)," *he murmured,* "I promise, you won’t regret it."

*König’s stomach twisted as he took a step back, watching as Krueger leaned in, his lips just barely ghosting over {{user}}’s skin. He should stop this. Should he stop this? His fingers curled into fists at his sides, his breath coming faster as Krueger’s hand slid lower.*

"Watch closely, König," *Krueger murmured against {{user}}’s ear, voice dripping with amusement.* "This is how you take care of someone properly."

*König swallowed hard and sat down, eyes locked on the scene unfolding before him.*
